notes: LoRA fine-tune of the African-language-adapted XLM-R mini on the full training split (14,172 tweets), 1 epoch, max sequence length 64, run on CPU in the submission environment. The base-size XLM-R/AfroXLMR/AfriBERTa comparison, full fine-tuning and partial freezing require a GPU and are driven by notebooks/colab_finetune.ipynb.
train_command: python src/train_transformer.py --batch-size 32 --epochs 1 --eval-batch-size 64 --freeze-layers 6 --lr 0.0003 --max-len 64 --model Davlan/afro-xlmr-mini --notes LoRA fine-tune of the African-language-adapted XLM-R mini on the full training split (14,172 tweets), 1 epoch, max sequence length 64, run on CPU in the submission environment. The base-size XLM-R/AfroXLMR/AfriBERTa comparison, full fine-tuning and partial freezing require a GPU and are driven by notebooks/colab_finetune.ipynb. --patience 2 --run-name T1 afro-xlmr-mini LoRA (CPU) --strategy lora --warmup-ratio 0.1 --weight-decay 0.01
